columns.name: ID
columns.description: A unique station identifier. NOTE: Extremely long IDs may not display correctly on this page but should be correct if this dataset is exported or accessed through the API.

columns.name: Short Name
columns.description: An alternative identifier used for some purposes.

columns.name: Total Docks
columns.description: Total docks in the station.  Each dock can accommodate one bicycle.

columns.name: Docks in Service
columns.description: Excludes docks taken out of service.  Calculated as the number of docks reported as containing available bicycles or available to receive a returned bicycle, as of the time this dataset was refreshed.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: The status of the station.  Stations "In Service" are available for use.

columns.name: Historical Wards 2003-2015 2
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Historical Wards 2003-2015' (awaf-s7ux) the point in column 'location_1' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
